facts: M-069 (2026-05-17, Session W): fixed a 100x units bug in alpha_engine/charter_slippage.py::deduct_slippage. It assumed pnl_pct is percentage-points (1.0==1%) and deducted 2*one_way_bps/100; every real caller (dashboard_generator verdict aggregate L14414, stamp_pick_net_pnl -> outcome_resolver) feeds the FRACTIONAL ledger value (closed_picks.json pnl_pct: 99%+ of rows in [-1,1], -0.0328==-3.28%). So an 8bp CRYPTO round-trip was subtracted as 8 percentage points — flipping real wins to losses across the whole verdict aggregate. Fix: deduct round_trip_bps/10000 (bps->fraction). 11/11 test_charter_slippage.py pass after migrating assertions to the fraction convention. Verdict shift (sim): buggy slippage crushed every class to ~0% WR; correct slippage gives COMMODITY 63%WR/PF2.45, CRYPTO 49%/0.53, EQUITY 40%/0.96, FOREX 28%/0.35. No class crosses sizing_allowed PF>=1.0 — no blocked->allowed flip. PR #1162 merged. Prerequisite for M-067.

facts: Session 2026-05-17 — Equities-IPO research sub-class shipped (PR #1142 merged). After a 9-report AI-auditor marathon (Ernie/GLM confabulated; MiMo/Sauna did real clones), assessed cheap-stock/IPO/penny-stock trading. VERDICT: true penny stocks <$1 NOT systematically tradable (3-10% round-trip spreads eat alpha); IPO first-day pop not reachable without offer-price allocation. The ONE defensible approach = IPO lock-up-expiry SHORT anomaly (Field & Hanka 2001, Brav & Gompers 2003) — 180-day insider lock-up expiry creates predictable selling pressure. SHIPPED as opt-in research sidecar (Wire-Up Rule compliant, NOT wired to production): alpha_engine/ipo_data_pipeline.py (Nasdaq IPO calendar + SEC EDGAR + Yahoo fetch, lock-up-date computation, SHORT signal gen source_system=ipo_pipeline) + alpha_engine/ipo_lockup_strategy.py (backtester: short 5d pre-lockup, cover 10d post, 15% stop/10% TP, 2% slippage + live signal generator). py_compile clean + unit-tested. Wiring Plan: passes_active_gate admits ipo_pipeline ONLY after a >=2yr backtest clears the universal 5-gate (DSR>=0.95, PBO<0.05, WF decay>=0, n>=100, 30d rolling-clean). WR estimates 58-62% are literature not system-verified. updates/index.html got an Equities-IPO entry with before/after filter state (production pick flow + HC filter UNCHANGED). KEY SESSION LESSON: AI auditors confabulate when they cannot clone the repo (Ernie invented strategies/files) or overfit (MiMo conf>=0.8 = 3 overfit ML models, FOREX cta_replicator = resolver-replay artifact). The cloud-agent prompt now has anti-fantasy gates: proof-of-access (git HEAD + real strategy names), inverse-projection rule (no 1/PF), recency-window rule (no last-10/last-50 cherry-pick). MASTER_ACTION_PLAN amended §23 with M-060..M-064. No asset class is real-money ready.

facts: Session 2026-05-17 (Claude Opus 4.7) - LMArena action-program completion. ACHIEVEMENTS: Completed + merged the full 9-item LMArena/OLLAMA action program across 5 PRs - #1120 (A1 meta-label shadow gate in quality_gates.passes_active_gate + A5 COMMODITY PF verify), #1122 (A4 FOREX ATR mutation / A6 confidence-calibrator refit / A8 canonical PF registry), #1123 (A9 emitter idempotency guard alpha_engine/emitter_dedup.py), #1129 (A2 overconfidence-decay hash-bucketed A/B + A3 vol-scalar cohort-replay backtest), #1127 (crypto-audit C2/C3/C4 net-PnL PF). Fixed the consult-grok skill. Broadcast session summary to peers via holographic memory (commit 7736c8e4d38). KEY FINDINGS: A8 PF registry found 41% of the entire closed-pick ledger is duplicate re-emissions - the single biggest data-integrity finding; COMMODITY multi_asset_cot CT=F PF is INFLATED (true ~4.69 not 21.33, 65% of its picks are COT re-emissions, winners re-emitted up to 9x); A6 OOS test shows only EQUITY confidence-calibrator passes - FOREX calibrator is a sign-flip hazard, do NOT enable global CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATION_ENABLED; A4 FOREX ATR-normalization NO-VIABLE-SUBSET, FOREX stays hard-disabled; O3 confidence inversion is NOT a Beta-prior bug (calibrator uses isotonic regression, default-off). LESSONS LEARNED: (1) This repo is a peer-storm-commit repo - multiple Claude instances constantly git-checkout the shared 21k-file working tree, which WIPED uncommitted subagent edits twice. FIX: always run subagent code work in worktree-isolation (Agent isolation=worktree), and consolidate commits via a fresh worktree off origin/main + cherry-pick, never trust the shared checkout HEAD. (2) consult-grok skill bug: wsl inherits Windows TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP (C:/Users/.../AppData/Local/Temp); grok aborts with --single: prompt is empty. FIX: wsl --cd /tmp bash -lc unset TMPDIR TEMP TMP then grok. (3) Ollama cloud auth drops mid-session (needs ollama signin); HF Inference API credits depleted - rotate models, dont assume cloud stays up. (4) Grok steering: when 41pct of the ledger is duplicate noise, fix the emitter/resolver pipeline FIRST before chasing per-class edge - downstream PF/calibrator numbers are all phantom until the data source is idempotent. (5) swarm-v2 PR review (python -m swarms.cli.main pr-review --pr N from tools/swarm_v2) is the reliable approval gate; swarm-approved means merge same turn. REMAINING: A7 cross-asset COT overlay (XL), live 30d validation windows for A1/A2/A3/A6, Grok-recommended A1 shadow->enforce promotion beyond EQUITY.

facts: KEY FINDING 2026-05-17: dependency-audit subagent found 6 third-party packages imported by repo code but declared in NO requirements*.txt — yfinance (148 files), pymysql (54), redis (20), beautifulsoup4/bs4 (9), mysql-connector-python/mysql.connector (8), PyYAML/yaml (5). Every CI job that pip-installs requirements then runs those modules hits ModuleNotFoundError; this was the true root cause of the ETF/Bond scanners emitting 0 picks (the per-scanner failover only patched the symptom). Fixed in PR #1137. Import-name vs PyPI-name mismatches (bs4/yaml/mysql.connector) make these easy to miss in an audit. Repo also uses TWO MySQL drivers (pymysql + mysql-connector-python) — worth standardizing.

facts: LESSON — multi-instance git in findtorontoevents_antigravity.ca (2026-05-17): shared .git/index corrupts ('index file smaller than expected') from concurrent peer git ops across multiple Claude instances sharing one working tree. Recover with `rm .git/index && git reset` (working tree untouched, only staged state lost; peers re-stage after). Stage+commit must be atomic in one shell command with a lock-retry loop, else peers clobber the index between `git add` and `git commit` (split a commit once). LESSON — delegation: WSL `grok -p` headless is unreliable here (produced no output, hung). Local Ollama index builds cannot delegate to Grok — Grok runs in WSL and cannot reach Windows Ollama loopback.
